audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart claims Gangplank wins Level 1 and Level 6, and claims Darius wins at two-plus items, while the prose in the same entry says the opposite.
audit.why: Darius has only Decimate at level 1 and still out-trades a 625-range Parrrley; at 6 Noxian Guillotine is a kill threat GP cannot answer in a duel (Cannon Barrage is a zone, 160s at rank 1). At two-plus items crit barrels plus Remove Scurvy flip the lane, which the entry's own 'late' text and whys[6] already state.
audit.corrected: Chart becomes Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Gangplank in both layers.
sources: internal contradiction with whys[6] and content.late

audit.why: Spike list is right: Darius spikes at 2-3, 6 and Stridebreaker; Gangplank spikes on Sheen/Trinity and crit barrels. Corrected the two-item ownership on the chart to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry repeatedly credits Gangplank's passive Trial by Fire with cleansing and healing, and calls Darius's slow a 'Q slow'.
audit.why: Trial by Fire is a periodic burn on his melee strike. The cleanse-and-heal is Remove Scurvy (W), 22/20/18/16/14s, 60-100 mana, and it cures crowd control. Darius's slows are Crippling Strike (W) and Apprehend (E); Decimate (Q) has no slow, it heals off champions hit by the blade.
audit.corrected: Name Remove Scurvy (W) as the cleanse with its 14s rank-5 cooldown, and attribute Darius's slow to Crippling Strike/Apprehend.

audit.whatIsWrong: Advice tells you to engage 'on Powder Kegs's cooldown'.
audit.why: Powder Keg has no cooldown in Riot's data (0) — it is charge-based, so the real read is charges spent, not a timer. Apprehend's 26s at rank 1 is the punishable cooldown in this lane.
audit.corrected: Engage when his barrel charges are spent; treat Apprehend as the cooldown you must not waste.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Remove Scurvy answers the slow your run-down depends on.
audit.why: Darius sticks with Crippling Strike and Apprehend slows; a cured slow is the whole reason he cannot finish a farmed GP.
audit.corrected: Stated in spikes[3], late and wants.foe[1].

edits.before: Your AA + W chop wins most level-1 exchanges, and every auto starts the Hemorrhage clock. Trade on his last-hits but don't chase past the wave.
edits.after: Only Decimate is up, and its outer ring heals off him while starting the Hemorrhage clock. Trade as he last-hits; Parrrley at 625 range just plinks minions.

edits.before: You stay a side-lane terror but fall off vs grouped teams. Look for flank pulls in fights; one reset chain can win the game.
edits.after: Crit barrels and Parrrley kite you from a screen away, and Remove Scurvy cures your slow. Flank from fog for a pull chain.

edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs: matchup-defining — Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Track it before every engage. - Your engage/committal tool: never waste it on chip damage. - Your ultimate: the win condition — spend it on kill windows, not on waves.
edits.after: - Powder Keg banks charges rather than a cooldown — pop them to deny poke and gold, then engage while he is empty. - Remove Scurvy (W) cures your slow, 14s at rank 5. - Apprehend is 26s at rank 1: never spend it on chip damage.

edits.before: - Darius vs Gangplank - Track: Gangplank Powder Kegs. - Keep the wave on your side. - Engage only on Powder Kegs's cooldown. - Don't chase past the wave. - Spend your ultimate on kill windows only.
edits.after: - Darius vs Gangplank - Track: Gangplank Powder Kegs. - Keep the wave on your side. - Engage once his barrel charges are spent. - Don't chase past the wave. - Spend your ultimate on kill windows only.

edits.before: Sheen and Trinity turn GP's Parrrley and barrels into real burst, and his passive Trial by Fire heal-and-cleanse lets him shrug off your slow. You're still favored close up, but respect his barrel combo when your E is down.
edits.after: Sheen and Trinity turn GP's Parrrley and barrels into real burst, and Remove Scurvy (W) cures your Crippling Strike slow and heals him — Trial by Fire is only a burn. You're favored close up, but respect barrels when E is down.

edits.before: A farmed GP is the classic Darius counter-scaler: barrel chains crit and slow you from range so you never touch him, his passive cleanses your Q slow, and Cannon Barrage zones your all-ins. Kill him early or he simply kites you forever.
edits.after: A farmed GP is the classic Darius counter-scaler: barrel chains crit and slow you from range so you never touch him, Remove Scurvy cures your W and E slows every 14s, and Cannon Barrage zones your all-ins. Kill him early or he kites you forever.

edits.before: Use passive cleanse to shrug off your Q slow
edits.after: Remove Scurvy (W) cures your W and E slows

edits.before: After first item into two-plus, Gangplank flips it. Sheen-powered crit barrels poke and slow you from a screen away, his passive cleanses the Q slow you depend on to stick, and Cannon Barrage zones your engages. This is a hard kiting matchup late — snowball your early lead before he comes online.
edits.after: After first item into two-plus, Gangplank flips it. Sheen-powered crit barrels poke and slow you from a screen away, Remove Scurvy cures the Crippling Strike slow you need to stick (14s at rank 5), and Cannon Barrage zones your engages. Snowball your early lead before he comes online.

notes: Riot's derived flags tag Cannon Barrage with trueDamage; the ability description only says slowing and damaging, so I did not assert true damage anywhere. Powder Keg's cooldown field is 0 (charge-based) — treat 'barrel cooldown' language across the site as suspect.
